GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

Before you
make your move.

Can I check the laptop before buying?

Yes. Visit Sanjay Place, Agra to inspect the actual unit, check its battery health and try the keyboard, screen and ports. Confirm the exact shop address before travelling.

What warranty comes with my laptop?

Warranty and return terms depend on the individual unit. Ask the store to confirm the coverage, duration and exclusions in writing before purchase.

Can I sell or exchange my laptop?

Use our valuation checklist to record your brand, model and condition. A final buyback or exchange offer is subject to inspection and store confirmation.

Do these photos show the exact unit I’ll receive?

The gallery uses reference product photos with backgrounds removed. It shows the model’s design from different angles. Confirm photos, condition and battery health of the exact unit with the store before purchase.
